During the first few months of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a '''mission''' was undertaken by a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], to destroy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Iridonia communications center|communications center]] on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. They were under orders from [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent [[Acaadi]], who had infiltrated their group and convinced them to follow his leadership. Acaadi used the Mandalorians to attack the Republic communications center in order to destroy it in advance of a planned Sith [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|attack on Iridonia]].
